data_quality_issue: EV Observed Duration vs Full Trip Travel Time
notes: Observed duration is the tracked window from initial EV insertion (t_min) to network exit (t_max). In all 120 runs, EV exited before max_steps (3600), achieving 100% arrival rate.
Calculated as sum of seconds where EV speed < 0.1 m/s from second-by-second telemetry. Replaces the legacy bugged zero-valued EV waiting-time metric.
Re-derived from velocity threshold crossings (speed transitions from >= 0.1 m/s to < 0.1 m/s). Corrects legacy 0-stop reporting.
Queue length is aggregated as the mean across simulation seconds of instantaneous queued vehicle counts across all incoming lanes.
Reported as seconds per vehicle accumulated across all simulated background vehicles.
Total throughput is the cumulative integer count of completed background trips exiting the network during the simulation episode duration.
